Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, the top prizes are being claimed faster than the tickets are selling, which is a reason to be careful.

Today's free summary of "BIG BANK PAYDAY" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.

2414.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "PREMIER PLAY", most are still unsold. The game is early in its run, with three of three top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Tomorrow's count on "PREMIER PLAY" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.

2415.body:
"Double The Money" has two of three top prizes left and is in the middle of its run. About half of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

If you play "Double The Money" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.

2422.body:

How far "Platinum 7s" is through its run does not decide anything by itself. It changes how closely to look at the other numbers.
